chunks: As for what Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā narrated from Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl ibn Bazīʿ, from his paternal uncle Ḥamzah ibn Bazīʿ, from ʿAlī ibn Suwayd, from al-Riḍā عليه السلام, concerning...

Regarding what is known, he said about salat over funerals: He said: In the first, you recite Umm al-Kitāb; in the second, you invoke blessings upon the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and his family; in the third, you supplicate for the believing men and the believing women; in the fourth, you supplicate for your deceased; and with the fifth, you depart.

key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: salat, here referring to the funeral prayer
key_terms.النَّبِيِّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.الْجَنَائِزِ: funerals, meaning the deceased over whom the prayer is performed
key_terms.مَيِّتِكَ: your deceased, the dead person for whom the prayer is offered

ai.seo_question: What should be recited in each stage of salat over the deceased in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the sequence of what is said in salat over the deceased, assigning specific recitations and supplications to each takbir stage. It is significant in discussions of prayer rulings for funeral prayer, especially concerning recitation, salawat, and du'a for the believers and the deceased.
